title: Pan-Seared Snapper with German Spice
description: A flavorful and delicate snapper dish inspired by German cuisine, featuring a crispy crust and a hint of Tunisian spice.
instructions: Season the snapper fillets with salt, black pepper, and Tunisian spice blend.
In a shallow dish, mix together flour, egg, and breadcrumbs. Dip each snapper fillet into the mixture, coating both sides evenly.
Heat butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the coated snapper fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
Serve the snapper hot with a squeeze of lemon and garnished with parsley.
Recommended side dishes: German potato salad, sauerkraut, or steamed vegetables.
